glosses: matter (the basic structural component of the universe)

examples.text: Estamos de acuerdo en esta materia.
examples.en: We are in agreement on this subject.

examples.text: Somos un país pobre en materias primas.
examples.en: We're a country poor in raw materials.

examples.text: La materia que discutimos es interesante.
examples.en: The matter we're discussing is interesting.

examples.text: Ella le aconseja en materias técnicas.
examples.en: She advises him on technical matters.
